[Flags] public enum Discipline Fields Any = 0 The command is available in all possible disciplines. Architecture = 1 The command is available in the Architecture discipline. Electrical = 64 The command is available in the Electrical discipline. ElectricalAnalysis = 1024 The command is available in the ElectricalAnalysis discipline. EnergyAnalysis = 16 The command is available in the EnergyAnalysis discipline. MassingAndSite = 8 The command is available in the Massing and Site discipline. Mechanical = 32 The command is available in the Mechanical discipline. MechanicalAnalysis = 256 The command is available in the MechanicalAnalysis discipline. Piping = 128 The command is available in the Piping discipline. PipingAnalysis = 512 The command is available in the PipingAnalysis discipline. StructuralAnalysis = 4 The command is available in the StructuralAnalysis discipline. Structure = 2 The command is available in the Structure discipline. Remarks Note that there are a few conditions where the Revit API framework prevents commands from being available always: When the user has another Revit command active, e.g. creating Windows, Doors, or editing sketches. When the active view is in perspective mode, or when the view is a Walkthrough, Drawings Lists, View Lists, Note Blocks, View Lists, etc.

index.html.summary: dosymep.Autodesk Welcome to the documentation for dosymep.Autodesk, a collection of .NET libraries designed to streamline development for Autodesk products like Revit and Navisworks. Overview This project provides several independent but related modules to handle various aspects of Autodesk software interaction: FileInfo: Extract metadata and previews from .rvt, .rfa, and Navisworks files efficiently. Journaling: Automate Revit operations by generating and modifying journal files. Revit Server: Programmatically manage models and folders on Revit Server.
